phrase: an Assistive Tech for the Visually Impaired Business
verdict: Yes, as a mission-led business. Torch-it from Ahmedabad pitched devices for visually impaired people on Shark Tank India Season 1, but didn't get a deal. Assistive devices change lives, and CSR and government programmes fund them.
angle: Smart canes and wearable devices help visually impaired people move independently. Government schemes, NGOs and CSR budgets buy in bulk.
